description:
Generate a machine-readable /pricing.md for AI shopping/agent flows. Finds the site's pricing page (or uses `pricing_url`), extracts named tiers and price lines, and returns the file content as a string.

Read-only. Issues a few HTTP GETs probing common pricing paths. Deterministic; no LLM. Does NOT write or upload — the caller hosts the file at `https://<domain>/pricing.md`.

When to use: a SaaS/e-commerce site that wants agents to read pricing without parsing a JS-rendered table. Falls back to a fill-in template when no prices are detectable.

domain.description: Hostname or origin to generate pricing.md for, e.g. `example.com`. The tool finds the pricing page (or uses `pricing_url`), extracts tiers and prices, and returns a machine-readable pricing.md string. Read-only.

pricing_url.description: Explicit pricing page URL. If omitted, the tool probes common paths (/pricing, /plans, /pricing/).

name: pricing_generate

pricing_md.description: The generated pricing.md content. Caller hosts it at /pricing.md.

source_url.description: The pricing page the content was derived from (null when none was found).

validation_issues.description: Issues encountered while deriving the file.

category.description: Finding category - which AI-SEO dimension it relates to.

estimated_impact.description: Estimated impact on AI citation probability when resolved.

failure_signal.description: Falsifiability: the observable signal that would prove the fix did NOT work.

leading_indicator.description: Falsifiability: the leading indicator to monitor to confirm the fix is landing.

severity.description: Triage priority: critical blocks AI citation, warning hurts probability, info is nice-to-have.

where.description: Location of the issue (CSS selector, JSON-LD path, robots.txt line, or 'page-level').

title: Generate pricing.md
